sloka: भगवँल्लब्धवानस्मि वरमिष्टं पितामहात् ।तं पश्य भगवन्कञ्चिन्निवासं साधु मे प्रभो ।। ७.३.२३ ॥
transliteration: bhagavam̐llabdhavānasmi varamiṣṭaṁ pitāmahāt ।taṁ paśya bhagavankañcinnivāsaṁ sādhu me prabho ।। 7.3.23 ॥

translations.english: Ravana informed his father that he had received his desired boon from Brahma and requested his father to find a suitable dwelling place for him.
